LESSON: REPRODUCTION IN HUMAN BEINGS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Living Things and their Environment
Topic 2.3: Reproduction in human beings

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Reproduction in human beings
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How best can challenges related to the menstrual cycle be managed?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe fertilisation and implantation in human beings
2. explain prevention measures for common STIs in human beings
3. appreciate the need for a healthy reproductive system

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Reproduction in human beings

Teach
• Observe Reproduction in human beings in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Reproduction in human beings (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Reproduction in human beings.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Reproduction in human beings.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Reproduction in human beings.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• describe fertilisation and implantation in human beings
• explain prevention measures for common STIs in human beings
• appreciate the need for a healthy reproductive system

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Reproduction in human beings.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Reproduction in human beings: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How best can challenges related to the menstrual cycle be managed?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe fertilisation and implantation in human beings
• explain prevention measures for common STIs in human beings
• appreciate the need for a healthy reproductive system

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
